Now our one suggestion for improvement that is slightly out of our hands is our term limits.

It is the board's recommendation that council consider amending the board's term limits to two years rather than just one.
Because it does take at least a year for a member to be fully trained.
Now we've spoken at length about this as a board and we're happy to conduct a jurisdictional scan and provide a report back to finance and to council for your consideration.
Because we want to make sure that the process around the report back remains independent of administration and council so that we can make sure that that independence is respected.
But it's really about making sure our members have some time to get trained before they have to go through the reappointment process.
And in conclusion I just want to say that as we continue to improve our operations and consistency as a board.
Council can take great confidence that this board is one of the most professional collegial and educated boards that I've had the pleasure of sitting on.
